name: SFTP Downloader
description: Downloads the files in a folder on an SFTP server to the Omniscope server and lists them, ready for an Append files block to load.
introductoryText:
Downloads the files in one folder of an SFTP server (optionally only those with given extensions) to a folder on the Omniscope server, and outputs one record per file with its local path.

**How to set it up**: enter the server, port, user name and a password or private key; the folder; and which files to take. To load the files' contents, connect the output to an **Append files** block set to use the file paths from the upstream block (the *File path* field).

**Host key**: paste the server's SHA256 fingerprint (from your administrator, or `ssh-keyscan host | ssh-keygen -lf -`) so the block refuses a server that is not the one you expect. Left empty, any key is accepted and the final message shows the key it saw.

options.name: username
options.title: User name
options.description: The account to sign in to the SFTP server with.

options.name: password
options.title: Password
options.description: The account's password, or the passphrase of the private key. Can be empty when a key without a passphrase is used.

options.name: privateKeyFile
options.title: Private key file
options.description: Optional: a private key file on the Omniscope server (OpenSSH format) to sign in with instead of, or as well as, the password.

options.name: hostname
options.title: Host name
options.description: The SFTP server, such as sftp.example.com.

options.name: hostKey
options.title: Host key
options.description: The server's key fingerprint, such as SHA256:Kx3c..., or its known_hosts line. The block stops if the server offers a different key. Empty: any key is accepted.

options.name: folder
options.title: Folder on the SFTP server
options.description: The folder whose files to download, such as /outgoing/daily. Sub-folders are not entered.

options.name: extension
options.title: Files to download
options.description: Extensions or patterns, separated by commas: csv, xlsx or sales_*.csv (not case-sensitive). Empty: every file in the folder.

options.name: localFolder
options.title: Download to folder
options.description: A folder on the Omniscope server to save the files in (created if missing; files of the same name are replaced). Empty: the block's own working folder.

blockOutputs.label: Files
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per downloaded file: File path (on the Omniscope server), File name, Size (bytes) and Modified (on the SFTP server, UTC).
